dataset_name: User Custom Railway Inspection & Defect Dataset
description: User-defined schema structure for training Indian Railways AI agents with custom fields.

columns.name: asset_code
columns.description: Custom asset identifier or equipment tag

columns.name: defect_type
columns.description: Flaw description e.g. Transverse Crack, Weld Slag, Missing ERC

columns.name: measurement_value_mm
columns.description: Direct physical measurement such as crack length, gap or wear in mm

columns.name: annual_traffic_gmt
columns.description: Gross Million Tonnes carried per year

columns.name: dynamic_vibration_g
columns.description: OMS or onboard accelerometer peak oscillation in g

columns.name: inspection_method
columns.description: Detection source: USFD, Drone, OMS, Trackman Patrol, ITMS

columns.name: defect_severity_level
columns.description: Target label to predict: P1 (Emergency), P2 (Urgent), P3 (Routine), P4 (Monitored)
